script:
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/prepare-for-sandbox-pause --expect 204
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A" --expect 200 --check id eq "$A"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/runtime" --expect 200 --check runtime_status eq available
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/events/search" --expect 409 \
  --check detail eq credential_binding_activation_required --check retryable eq true --save F12.binding-required-after-pause/events
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/run" --expect 409 --check detail eq credential_binding_activation_required
control-agent-server ws listen "/sockets/events/$A" --expect-close 1013 --duration 10 --save F12.binding-required-after-pause/events-socket \
  | jq -e '.close.reason == "credential_binding_activation_required"'
control-agent-server ws listen "/sockets/session/$A" --query after_seq=-1 --expect-close 1013 --duration 10
control-agent-server state ls --conversation "$A" owner_lease.json --expect-count 0
control-agent-server api PUT "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/credential-bindings/CODEX_AUTH_JSON" --json "{\"url\": \"$SRC/cred\"}" --expect 204 --save F12.binding-required-after-pause/reactivate
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$A/events/search" --expect 200 --save F12.binding-required-after-pause/events-after
control-agent-server state ls --conversation "$A" owner_lease.json --expect-count 1
